title: Unable to use gds custom translation resources normally.
body: ### Tested versions 4.7 master ### System information Godot v4.7.dev.mono (47415cf3a) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 06 Feb 2026 21:49:55 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.46 GiB memory ### Issue description 1. Adding custom translation resources for GDS to `locale/translations` will fail to load. 2. Using custom translation resources from GDS may cause the program to crash upon exit. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59d56da2-d6d4-4fa2-b130-9f2b5e5987a5 gdb: ``` Thread 1
